candidate_order: Latest event among all four event types descending, product ID ascending; append unseen past distinct-buyer popularity products, product ID ties; take first 100

ranking_methods.global_popularity: All historical products' distinct-buyer counts descending, then product ID ascending; absent counts are zero
ranking_methods.personal_recency: Personal-history products first; latest event among all four event types descending; past distinct-buyer count descending; product ID ascending; unseen products use popularity then ID

primary_comparison: Validation mean per-purchasing-customer Recall@10 and NDCG@10; report disagreement instead of changing rules
recall: Macro mean among eligible purchasers primary; micro purchased-pair recall separately
ndcg: Binary gains, log2(rank+1) discount; ideal uses min(K, all distinct future purchased products), including those outside candidates; macro among eligible purchasers
empty_outcome_policy: Exclude from undefined purchase recall/NDCG averages, retain in scoring and coverage
cold_start_policy: Empty personal history falls back to popularity; zero such customers in the historical-activity eligible cohort means observed cold-start metrics are null
history: Previous calendar month, inclusive start and exclusive prediction timestamp, UTC
outcome: Fourteen days from prediction timestamp, inclusive start and exclusive end, UTC
reserved_final_snapshot: 2020-01-01; no final-test labels accessed or evaluated in this phase
scope: Two deterministic ordering baselines only; no training, retrieval tuning or final-test evaluation
